title: The Wisdom of the Loudest: A Large-Scale Audit of Generative Search on Reddit
abstract: arXiv:2609.14575v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online communities are valued not only for answers, but for the diversity of experiences and perspectives they contain. Generative search increasingly mediates access to this discourse, yet little is known about which community voices survive retrieval and synthesis. We audit Reddit Answers using 10,000 queries from 20 advice- and support-seeking communities, repeated three times to produce 30,000 answers over 14.68M comments. We find that differences across runs are driven primarily by retrieval, answers routinely combine evidence across communities, and selection strongly favors already-visible, top-level comments. Formal and directive language is more likely to be surfaced, while experiential voice is less likely to survive selection and is further weakened during synthesis, with first-person singular language declining sharply. translated_title: 最响亮者的智慧：对Reddit上生成式搜索的大规模审计
translated_abstract: 在线社区的价值不仅在于提供答案，更在于其所包含的多样化的经验和观点。生成式搜索日益成为获取这些话语的中介，然而关于哪些社区声音能够在检索与合成过程中留存下来，我们知之甚少。我们使用来自20个寻求建议和支持社区的10,000个查询对Reddit Answers进行审计，每个查询重复三次，共产生30,000个答案，涵盖1468万条评论。我们发现，不同运行之间的差异主要由检索环节驱动；答案通常会跨社区组合证据；且评论选择强烈偏向于已经可见的顶层评论。正式和指令性的语言更容易被呈现出来，而经验性的声音则更难在筛选中存活，并在合成过程中进一步被削弱，表现为第一人称单数语言的急剧减少。这些发现表明，基于社区的生成式搜索并非中立的总结，应当……
tldr: 对Reddit生成式搜索的大规模审计发现，其机制偏向已可见的顶层评论和正式指令性语言，而经验性声音被系统性削弱，表明基于社区的生成式搜索并非中立的总结。
en_tdlr: A large-scale audit of Reddit Answers shows that generative search favors already-visible top-level comments and formal directive language while systematically weakening experiential voices, revealing that community-grounded generative search is not neutral summarization.
